use_case_summary: Customer support chat agent that streams assistant tokens to web clients, must support tool calling (ticket create, KB lookup) and maintain tight first-token latency (<1.5s P95). Evaluate Hosted API first; move to Dedicated for committed throughput and SLAs if cost/latency advantages justify.
poc_details: 2-week hosted POC: 3 load profiles (low/med/peak), synthetic and replay of 5k real customer transcripts
Metrics collected: 1st-token latency (median/P95/P99), end-to-end tool-call latency, streaming stability, error rates, token costs
Tool-call flow: user -> assistant resolves intent -> function call(ticket.create) -> DB embedding lookup -> final structured reply (function result streaming)
Targets: 1st-token P95 <=1.5s, function call added latency <=200ms (excluding external ticketing service), sustained 60 RPS with <2% error rate
SE notes: enable prefix caching for frequent KB queries; recommend small batching window for peak throughput to balance latency/cost
